scope: Staged credential YAML collection/merge admission and byte-preserving recognized flat-layout upgrade

paired.comparison: All admission results and schema diagnostics, plus every flat migration result string. Runtime YAML syntax/tag-recovery diagnostic interiors remain normalized with both originals retained, as documented in C8-FZ.

verification.source: The new 379-case corpus invokes the actual unchanged fixed Source parser and flat-layout renderer. The earlier C8-FZ 36 Source record/migration/review tests were not redundantly rerun.
verification.scope_reason: Adds JS Map/Set/pairs versus enumerable object semantics, typed timestamp/binary admission across root/section/record/payload/version/kind positions, original Source diagnostic serialization, YAML 1.1 merge ordering versus YAML 1.2 literal merge-key rejection, and flat upgrade text with annotations, CRLF, directives and alias rejection.

behavior: YAML sets and ordered maps behave as JS objects with no own enumerable string properties; pairs keep their pair-object array shape. Non-JSON collection payloads are rejected and malformed collection tags fail safely.
Timestamp and binary values follow Source enumerable-property and diagnostic rules, including Buffer JSON output when used as an invalid version or record kind.
YAML 1.1 merge sources fill absent properties, preserve explicit overrides in either ordering and honor sequence source precedence. Ordinary YAML 1.2 << stays a normal key.

Only a nonempty mapping of scalar addressable names to nonempty scalar strings is automatically upgraded. The original body is indented without reserializing annotations, line endings or scalar spelling; directives/document markers and alias values are refused.
diagnostics: The expanded corpus identified collection-object admission and enumerable-property differences, which are now represented explicitly.
Source Node Buffer.toJSON differs from a typed byte array property map; diagnostic serialization now uses the actual pinned Buffer shape.
limits: Production provider activation remains pending the storage/editor/queue/disposal contract; no new parser is registered by this part.

This is qualified corpus coverage, not a claim of universal YAML conformance. Complex collection-key formatting, merge/alias resource-accounting interleavings and recursive invalid version/kind JSON diagnostics still need inspection when relevant to integration.
Targeted checks do not establish full migration or Portable/browser/Win7 release acceptance.
retained: Commands, raw comparisons, per-parser diagnostics and XML. No remaining owned fixture/process; shared Source/toolchains retained for C9.
